title: Hidden Browser Cart Debug Viewer

sections.name: Diagnostics
items: Open task logs and select Cart-only debug to watch screenshots from the actual hidden browser, separate from the CAPTCHA harvester.
Run a fresh-session product-to-cart test with live previews and before/after Add to Cart snapshots. Test runs stop before checkout and do not use profile or payment details.
Stop or close the viewer to cancel the test. Snapshots stay in memory and are cleared when the viewer closes; checkout and account pages are excluded.
Cart navigation ignores combined checkout controls, and hidden captures refresh their rendered frame without opening a browser window.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
